displayName: GHADV-3043: Keycloak has a Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
description:
Keycloak has a Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_race_condition_ghadv_3043", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%keycloak%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%time%') AND "value" > 0
